`interface ITweenPath`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`CatmullRomTweenPath`](/reference/animation/catmullromtweenpath/), [`LinearTweenPath`](/reference/animation/lineartweenpath/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.animation.tween` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ITweenPath.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/animation/tween/ITweenPath.java)

Curve that joins the start, the waypoints and the target of a tween.

## Description

[`TweenPaths`](/reference/animation/tweenpaths/) holds the curves of JOID; implement this interface for a path of your own.

### compute
